description:
G&A Solutions Engineering (GSE) is IS&T's dedicated technology partner for Apple's general and administrative functions — including people, finance, facilities, legal, and security. The team builds and delivers integrated technology solutions that keep these functions running efficiently and securely at global scale. GSE also works closely with business teams to develop custom tools that improve productivity and bring greater automation and consistency to G&A operations across Apple.

Description
As a Software Engineer you will be responsible for the technical design, coding, debugging of complex APIs & Micro services, and triaging bugs in several functional areas of the product.

Responsibilities
You will participate in the design & code reviews with other engineers in the team and will maintain a high engineering bar
You will also participate in product roadmap and project planning efforts. You will have a strong sense of ownership and passion for software engineering
You’ll work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment


Minimum qualifications
3 years of experience developing scalable Java applications, microservices and APIs using Spring Boot or Spring WebFlux for reactive, non-blocking systems
3 years of hands-on experience implementing and optimizing both Relational and Non-Relational database solutions
3 years of experience building event-driven systems and real-time data pipelines using streaming technologies like Apache Kafka or Flink
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or relevant work experience



Preferred qualifications
Good understanding of design patterns, solid principles, and OOP best practices to deliver clean, maintainable, and scalable codebases
Experience with RESTful API design, authentication/authorization mechanisms (OAuth, JWT etc), and API security best practices
Proven ability to manage complex data integrations and navigate the technical requirements of large-scale, global enterprise environments
